York Haven among 91 cities tied at 72nd in Pennsylvania for July scam reports
York Haven was one of 91 cities tied for 72nd among 372 Pennsylvania cities that had at least one BBB Scam Tracker report in July 2026, recording two reports, according to Better Business Bureau.
No scam reports were listed for the city in the prior month.
Dollar amounts reported for July 2026 in the city totaled $33.83 across one report, and the most common scam type was online purchase, with one report.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to show large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
